# QuickJS 2026-06-04

Unmodified runtime sources from the official QuickJS release.

- Homepage: https://bellard.org/quickjs/
- Source archive: https://bellard.org/quickjs/quickjs-2026-06-04.tar.xz
- Archive SHA-256: `b376e839b322978313d929fd20663b11ba58b75df5a46c126dd19ea2fa70ad2a`
- Retrieved: 2026-11-06
- License: MIT; see LICENSE and the notices retained in every source file.

Only the core interpreter, regexp, Unicode, dtoa and utility sources/headers are included.
The upstream command-line tools, libc/OS module, executable compiler, tests and examples are not bundled.
No filesystem, process, module loader or native dynamic-library API is exposed by the bridge.
No source patches are applied. Host integration lives in ../../ZhuyingScriptCore.
The SHA-256 pins the downloaded release bytes; it is not a publisher signature.
